title: Home asks about a column kept out on statistics alone before a build
request: Live finding through DCLab Code (HyperAck, 0.664 vs honest 0.945); the owner's rule: Home asks with the evidence, and 'use your recommendation' follows the leakage reviewer only when it says available and names the moment. Handed over by the Home session, which drafted column_check.py.
spec: dclab_rnd/draft/column_check.py (new), draft/api.py quick_build, draft/chat.py (ask_column_check, column_answer), tests/test_home_column_check.py
plan: port the Home session's WIP patch onto H4-H12's chat.py
test the decisions and the route end to end

decisions.decision: ask only about columns kept out on statistics alone (proof within R04/R05)
decisions.why: a name signal, a precedent, the research's own forbidden list or a label source is never overruled, even when the reviewer model says available

decisions.decision: a doubtful answer reads as later or as the recommendation
decisions.why: both keep the column out: the safe side of a leak

decisions.decision: an answer counts only for the outcome and moment it was given about
decisions.why: a new version copies the understanding with a new target

decisions.decision: a build Claude asks for through MCP still goes through home_build after the answer
decisions.why: A7: an external chat builds only through the call its host asks the person about

findings.defect: Home dropped an honest strong column without asking
findings.scenario: HyperAck through DCLab Code: deliverey_category_id forbidden on AUC 0.816 alone, reviewer said available, holdout 0.664 vs 0.945
findings.cause: statistics-only flags kept out unless confirmed, but nothing asked for the confirmation
findings.fix: the build refuses with a 'column check' and Home asks with the evidence, outside the question cap; the answer decides
findings.test: e2e route test: refused 409 naming the column, asked, 'known' keeps it with the reason in the notes

findings.defect: a late answer read as known
findings.scenario: 'yes it is written later', 'known after the delivery'
findings.cause: KNOWN matched the first word before any late word
findings.fix: LATE and HEDGE words: exact option, recommendation, late, then known without hedge

findings.defect: a precedent column could be kept on a plain yes
findings.scenario: the reviewer model wrongly says final_customer_fare is available
findings.cause: disputed() asked about every reviewer-available column
findings.fix: statistics-only with proof within R04/R05 only
findings.test: unit: precedent and R01 columns never asked

findings.defect: answers reused for a new outcome
findings.fix: answers stored with target and moment; current() ignores others

findings.scenario: 'Probably set at creation, though it could be updated after'
findings.cause: every reviewer reason quotes the moment
findings.fix: per clause, no hedge and no late word in that clause
findings.test: units: three hedged reasons, the real HyperAck reason

findings.defect: 'yes, I guess' read as known; 'set at completion' named a moment
findings.cause: HEDGE and LATE missed a few words

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: 435 tests in 22 files OK; tests/test_home_column_check 10 OK

measurements.name: home-eval rules
measurements.gate: fields 65 right 0 wrong, traps 6/6, uncited 0 (the Home session's dev baseline)

measurements.name: harness-eval
measurements.gate: every case right on every step

measurements.name: review
measurements.result: first review FAIL (4 high), all fixed; second review PASS

outcome: Home no longer drops an honest strong column silently: it asks with the evidence, and its recommendation follows the reviewer only when the reviewer plainly names the moment.
lessons: A recommendation that silently decides a leak is a default, and defaults need a question.
Every false-ask cut opens a door: read answers for the late word before the yes.
risks: Not yet rerun live on HyperAck through DCLab Code (next).
With the team switch on and no outcome named, the walk builds without this check (unchanged).
